method.agreement: Report the acoustic and transcript candidates separately. An agreed interval uses the submitted word times when both channels cover at least one third of the smaller interval and reach at least 0.20 intersection over union on both recordings' clocks.
method.assessment: A useful range covers at least half a labeled edit with at least 0.30 intersection over union on the submitted clock. Benchmarks measure differences against an earlier copy. No method establishes AI origin, and no new candidate enters overall confidence.
method.source: All matched SINE preview cases and paired ordinary controls. All PartialEdit originals and both named generators on their clean, +5 dB market, and -5 dB construction files. Both AMI assessment meetings and all five ordinary controls per excerpt.
method.speech: Deterministic CPU English decode, no prompts and no reference text. Use 20 ms word times on each file's 16 kHz analysis clock. Casefold and remove punctuation except apostrophes inside words. Skip a pair if either decoded word sequence lacks verified times.
method.witness: Require at least six matching words and common coverage of at least 65% of the longer sequence. Select only replacement blocks of one to four words, bounded immediately on both sides by two matching words whose sequences occur exactly once in both copies. The changed submitted words must occupy 80 ms to three seconds.
